create_generative_scoring: create generative scoring to compute probabilities of specified token IDs as next tokens after a query+item prompt
build_prompts_concatenate_query_items: build prompts by concatenating query and item token IDs with configurable ordering and truncation
compute_probabilities_from_logprobs: compute probabilities from logprobs using subset softmax or full vocab normalization
validate_label_token_ids_vocabulary: validate label token IDs are within the model vocabulary range before scoring
extract_trace_headers_from_request: extract distributed tracing headers from HTTP request headers for generative scoring requests
